$comment: The routine catalogue — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for routine ids, labels and artwork (memo §12; implementation-considerations §8; ui/design-system.md §2). No component or handler may hard-code a label or an artwork path; both surfaces (panel + remote UI) read identity from here. `artwork` is the remote's identity channel for the panel symbol; no icon font, no hard-coded path in any component. Id `cleanup` carries label 'Cleanup' on both surfaces.
